prompts.prompt: Analyze this image in detail. Provide: comprehensive description, identify text, analyze colors and composition, identify objects, emotional tone, notable elements, potential use cases.
Research [TOPIC] comprehensively. Structure: executive summary, key facts, historical context, current developments, multiple perspectives, future outlook, practical applications.
Generate production-ready code for [REQUIREMENT]. Include: clean implementation, error handling, documentation, unit tests, usage examples. Language: [LANGUAGE].
Summarize this document: [DOCUMENT]. Provide: executive summary, key points, important data, conclusions, action items. Format as structured bullet points.
Translate and localize [CONTENT] from [SOURCE] to [TARGET LANGUAGE]. Preserve: tone, cultural nuances, idioms, formatting. Note any cultural adaptations made.
